_meta.description: WawApp Dispatch Reliability Regression Memory. Every confirmed bug is immortalized here as a permanent test. must_never_fail_again=true means this scenario is permanently in the regression suite.

regressions.title: Stale SharedPreferences active-trip flag suppresses legitimate offers
regressions.description: MyFCMService read driver_has_active_trip=true from SharedPreferences even when the active trip was stale (>15 minutes). This caused the driver to silently suppress valid ride offers while appearing online and healthy.
regressions.root_cause: SharedPreferences stored a flat boolean with no TTL. On recovery from a crash, the flag was never cleared.
regressions.fix_description: Replaced flat boolean with structured JSON: {active, orderId, setAt, source}. Added stale threshold (15 min). Added auto-clear on foreground reconciliation.

evidence.log_marker: Driver has active trip — suppressing new offer

regressions.title: Fullscreen offer UI remains interactively alive after accept failure
regressions.description: After acceptOrderV2 returned an error (e.g., 'حدث خطأ'), the FullScreenNotificationActivity remained visible with active Accept/Reject buttons. The driver could continue tapping Accept, generating duplicate backend calls.
regressions.root_cause: No idempotency guard on the accept button. No _safeDismiss() call on terminal backend error codes.
regressions.fix_description: Added AcceptanceLockManager singleton. Accept button is disabled immediately on first tap. _safeDismiss() fires on backend errors (already_taken, offer_expired, max retry exceeded).

regressions.title: Firestore offline cache replays accepted/terminated offers on cold start
regressions.description: When the app was killed while an offer was in the local Firestore persistence cache (status=sent), and the offer was subsequently accepted on the backend, the local cache would replay the stale offer on cold restart. The driver saw a ghost offer for ~765ms before the server reconciliation fired.
regressions.root_cause: Firestore offline persistence is enabled (persistenceEnabled=true). The watchMyOffers stream does not filter isFromCache emissions. The first snapshot after cold start is always from cache.
regressions.fix_description: PENDING: Add isFromCache check to orders_service.dart watchMyOffers asyncMap. Only present offers where snapshot.metadata.isFromCache == false OR the sentAt timestamp is within a recent threshold.
regressions.invariant_protected: Cache snapshots cannot create false authority

regressions.title: Rapid double-tap on Accept triggers duplicate acceptOrderV2 calls
regressions.description: A driver could rapidly double-tap the Accept button before the loading state rendered, triggering multiple concurrent acceptOrderV2 Cloud Function calls for the same offer.
regressions.root_cause: No client-side idempotency guard. Button was not disabled on first tap. AcceptanceLockManager did not exist.
regressions.fix_description: AcceptanceLockManager uses an in-memory lock + SharedPreferences persistence. First tap acquires lock and disables button. Subsequent taps are dropped.

regressions.title: App shows stale offer as actionable on startup rehydration
regressions.description: On cold start after a previous session where an offer was dispatched, the Firestore cache causes the NearbyScreen to briefly render a dead offer as actionable before network sync corrects it.
regressions.root_cause: Same as stale_cache_resurrection. Firestore cache delivers stale snapshot before network handshake.
regressions.fix_description: PENDING: Same fix as stale_cache_resurrection — filter isFromCache in watchMyOffers.

regressions.title: Driver appears online but silently receives zero offers
regressions.description: A driver with driver_has_active_trip=true in SharedPreferences would appear online, heartbeat healthy, and location-updating, but every incoming offer was silently suppressed by MyFCMService. The driver would receive zero rides indefinitely.
regressions.root_cause: Stale SharedPreferences flag without TTL or reconciliation.
regressions.fix_description: Bounded-trust SharedPreferences with setAt timestamp. Auto-clear on foreground. Suppression telemetry added.
